project.title: Leishmania snf1 kinase knock out
project.projectDescription: A Knock out of the snf1 kinase homolog of Leishmania major was developed by CRISPR approach.Toidentify the change in protein expression a whole peoteome analysis was done to identify changes in gene expression levels at whole proteome level.
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: Guanidinum hydrochloride based extraction of the total proteins was performed. Following the extraction of proteins were purified by chloroform methanol protein extraction. equal quantity of protein was digested with trypsin and pufiried by c-18 columns and subjeted to thermofisher fusion mass spec instrument
project.dataProcessingProtocol: Data processing was done my maxquant followed by data processing by perseus
